explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this, and I didn't need a broad search to see why. The theorem says that any structure satisfying the library's own NF theory also satisfies the library's own `LiteralHailperinNF` axiom set, which it defines itself. The proof goes through each axiom name and applies one of the library's own `realizes_literalAx*` lemmas. Mathlib has no formalization of New Foundations or of Hailperin's finite axiomatization. The whole content of the statement sits in the library's definitions (`LNF`, `NF`, `LiteralHailperinNF`, `Fol.allRealizeSentence`), so no Mathlib declaration could state it.
